reviews.text: Thank you for the 5 stars, your support is appreciated.

Everybody at the Arch Clinic is very friendly, professional and caring. I have been taking my furry friends there to see Dr. Williams for almost 11 years. He is the best vet I've met. So caring and kind and he treats each pet with affection. Now Dr. Williams has a new vet partner who is as loving and caring for my pets as he is. I love how, especially under the circumstances, the office is always so clean and how professionally of a medical facility it looks and feels like a doctor's office. The staff is so welcoming, polite, and attentive. Your practice is well organized with no overflow of patients and long wait time. Also, I feel it was an exceptional courtesy to light a candle and small plaque asking arrivals to please help in keeping voices low while someone is saying goodbye to their family pet member. Keep up the amazing work.

Fantastic experience at Arch Creek Animal Clinic! I brought my French Bulldog, Ace, in unexpectedly on a Saturday for an urgent eye injury, and the team took such great care of him. They were compassionate, professional, and truly put my mind at ease. Highly recommend them to any pet parent! Updating my previous review: Took my dog Ace back here yesterday (August 27) for a follow-up checkup on his eye injury, and the exceptional care continues. The best!!! I found these guys because I lived nearby. I have now moved and realized I’d never dream of going anywhere else. Everyone is so friendly and reassuring when I am worried about things with my pup.  I cannot say enough good things and would highly recommend to any fellow helicopter dog parents.

I called to make an appointment for my small dog, who had been experiencing recurring respiratory issues for the past eight months. While the situation was not critical, it was something that needed attention sooner rather than later. I wasn't expecting a same-day appointment—anything within a couple of business days would have been perfectly reasonable—but they went out of their way to fit us in within an hour of my call.

The kindness started on the phone (Angelica) and only continued when we arrived. From the moment we walked through the door, the atmosphere was welcoming, compassionate, and professional. The staff greeted us warmly and immediately made us feel comfortable. It was obvious that they genuinely love and care about animals. Everyone who interacted with us was incredibly sweet and attentive.

Dr. Williams came into the exam room with a smile and took the time to listen carefully. Because I had kept detailed records of my dog's symptoms and history, the discussion was straightforward. After reviewing everything, he quickly identified a possible dental root infection as the source of her ongoing respiratory issues. His explanation made perfect sense, especially since a dental infection had been part of the original medical concerns eight months ago.

What impressed me most was that Dr. Williams and his team focused on addressing the most likely underlying cause first rather than immediately recommending a long list of costly tests and procedures. They developed a thoughtful treatment plan using medication and recommended waiting to see how she responds before pursuing additional scans if needed.

I left feeling heard, respected, and genuinely cared for. The entire experience exceeded my expectations, and I have absolutely no reservations about recommending this practice to anyone looking for compassionate, knowledgeable veterinary/specialty care.

The best vet practice in town. Everyone is kind, professional, and knowledgeable, going out of their way to help and providing the best quality care for your furry family members. So glad to have this clinic for my dog.
Dr Williams is a compassionate and knowledgable professional. His staff are competent and welcoming. I’ve been a loyal client for 8 years.
Great team at Arch Creek.

Dr Williams examined my Pomeranian said his luxating patella was completely slipped to the left of his leg causing Ray to keep his leg picked up. Dr Williams waited to make the diagnosis until the actual X-rays came and he was able to see the extent of Ray’s problem which I really appreciated. I felt that Dr Williams took his time with Ray to know what was wrong and I am going to have him preform the surgery.

This was my 1st visit there. My big boy needed his shots and was dealing with a skin rash / allergy.  Veterinarian prices are not cheap at all  (in my opinion) , however my dog is now feeling much better the itch is almost gone entirely.  Will come again if there are other issues.
Great service always caring for my beloved cat!

I have been taking my dogs to see Dr Williams for over a decade. He has been extremely kind and attentive to my dogs. He saved our dog many years ago and coordinated his cancer treatment with Hollywood Animal Hospital. We were able to get a few more years with our dog, before he passed. He sees our 2 (current) dogs regularly. He always completes thorough exams and explains all of our options for care.

Dr. Williams is knowledgeable and caring.  His staff efficient and gentle with the animals. I would highly recommend him. When I met my friend, we asked each other who our vet was and we both said that it was Dr. Williams and we both gave him a thumbs up.

Thank you so much, Wadah, for your 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and kind feedback. Our team at Arch Creek Animal Clinic is grateful for the opportunity to care for your pets, and we’re so happy you had a great experience with us. We look forward to seeing you again! 🐾 …
They are super nice and good price

Cat came back severely distressed after being taken to the back

I took my cat in on May 15, 2026, because she had missed the litter box earlier that morning. When we arrived, she was calm and stable with normal energy. After they took her to the back for examination, X-rays, and urinalysis, she was returned to me in a completely different condition — she was screaming, vomiting, twitching, and severely distressed. She had not been in this state when we arrived.
They listed a urinalysis and Onsior tablets on the estimate but provided no results and did not give me the medication. They sent us to the ER with almost no explanation of what they found. When I asked what caused the rupture in an indoor cat, the doctor had no clear answer.
The dramatic decline in her condition while she was in their care was very concerning. Communication was extremely poor throughout.

I came home to find drops of blood, large and small all over my place.  Called Arch Creek because my neighbor had recommended them and they had me bring her right over and Dr. Williams immediately diagnosed it and did the follow up tests which confirmed the diagnosis.  The care has been excellent, calls returned, helpful information shared.  I would highly recommend.
Second time that my teeny 3 1/2 lb Yorkie, Penny,  needed teeth cleaning and extraction.  Superb results!  Happy, healthy, Penny :)

TO MY BABY DUE TO YOUR NEGLIGENCE. THIS WILL HAVE NEVER HAPPEN IN MY COUNTRY JAPAN

I KNOW ALL REVIEWS ARE SUBJECTIVE, PEOPLE HAVE BAD EXPERIENCES, AND OTHERS, AMAZING EXPERIENCES. THIS IS COMING FROM A JAPANESE AMERICAN WOMAN, WHO TRAVELLED HERE FOR AN ANIMAL RESCUE EVENT. I NEEDED A VET IMMEDIATELY, I CAME WITHOUT READING THE REVIEWS, I WISH I HAD

BEFORE I WRITE A REVIEW, ID LIKE YOU TO KNOW THAT I GREW UP WITH HUNDREDS, UPON HUNDREDS OF DOGS, ABOUT A HUNDRED CATS, RACCOONS, RABBITS, UNWANTED HAMSTERS, GERBILS, FERRETS. I HAVE NEVER EXPERIENCED WHATS CALLED IN THE VET MEDICAL FIELD AS
***COMPASSION FATIGUE***

IN THE VETERINARIAN WORLD, COMPASSION FATIGUE IS DEFINED AS EMOTIONAL EXHAUSTION, AND RESUCED EMPATHY CAUSED BY CARING FOR TOO MANY SICK, INJURED, TERMINAL ANIMALS. THE VETERINARIAN EITHER LACKS EMPATHY, OR DOESNT SHOW, PERCEIVE, OR EVEN FAKE EMPATHY TO A PANICKED PATIENT, AND THEIR OWNER. BRITTANY SHOULD NOT BE FEELING THIS WAY, SHE IS A NEW VETERINARIAN. SHE JUST FINISHED HER RESIDENCY. IF YOURE TIRED NOW, IMAGINE TEN YEARS FEOM NOW

VETERINARIANS HAVE A DUTY, STANDARD, AND ARE EXPECTED TO SHOW KINDNESS, INDERSTANDINGNESS, EMPATHY TO AN OWNER WHO COMES IN WITH FEAR OF THE UNKNOWN, SADNESS, TO COMFORT THEM

DR BRITTANY OSEJO, SHAME ON YOU. SHAME. ON. YOU. You show no emotion or empathy for patients. You gave a horrendous diagnosis without running a simple blood test that would determine whether or not my dog had a diagnosis (That I was almost 100% certain of, and cannot name to remain anonymous) You thought it was a digestive issue, when it turns out it was a specific virus that affects 70-90% of up to 20 week old puppies. But there was still a possibility my dog could’ve had it. Had it been diagnosed in time, my dog would be alive. I had to go to emergency room. You showed absolutely no empathy. You’re almost robotic. It makes absolutely no sense whatsoever because you JUST RECEIVED YOUR VETERINARY DOCTORATE. You’re not a skilled, veteran, OG, vet. I’d expect that from a vet practicing for over 20+ years, and it says on your website you just became a doctor. Wrong career choice. And judging by another review, I’m not alone, and I believe I too will be filing a civil case, and you will be receiving a summons. I have a lot of documentation, and evidence. If I were you, I’d be very careful with future patients. You made me go home feeling ashamed, embarrassed, incredibly scared and fearful, with a pit so huge in my stomach I thought I’d die losing my baby. And when a few days later he wasn’t getting better, I knew in my heart I made a horrible mistake by not going to the emergency sooner due to your recommendation

I’m more horrified with your behavior. The pure robotic apathy, you come in, say something straight forward, and leave. You don’t even apologize for a dog being ill or feeling unwell. In Japan, the vets hold and kiss their patients. EVEN IF YOU FELT NO REMORSE, YOU COULDVE PRETENDED TO CARE. THATS 90% OF VETERINARY CARE. That’s all us owners want, is someone to care. I went home horrified, and angry. You’re in the wrong field. You can pretend all you want that you’re a veterinarian because you care about animals, you can pretend that you aren’t kind because you’re focused on their health, but that’s not the case. You aren’t either. If you’re neurodivergent, I don’t care. I’m not judging you. I’m judging your lack of judgement, care, and kindness. Our dogs, cats, birds, etc, they aren’t a “guessing game,” How can you sleep at night knowing clients and their owners go home feeling more confused than when they come in? I saw you come to the waiting room and approach two clients while I was waiting to see you. I saw the way they were treated. Like you were a customer service robot. I am so disappointed with Veterinary Medicine in general and especially with this veterinarian.  I took my 15lb Poodle mix to this clinic because my other Veterinarian does not do orthopedic surgeries.  I was told my dog had a ACL-ANTERIOR CRUCIATE LIGAMENT TEAR by my vet and that this clinic did this type of surgery.  I made an appointment and the Vet spent at MOST 5 minutes with my dog and confirmed the other vets diagnosis.  ACL tear.  Surgery would be $4000 and requires 8-16 weeks of rehab which we must keep dog calm restricting mobility to promote healing!  X-rays would be taken prior to surgery.               I couldn't afford the surgery but booked an appointment and applied for the credit card they promote.  But THANKFULLY  I decided to look into this issue online and found a lot of useful information.  A tear DOESN'T always require SURGERY!  Sometimes rest and containing dog so it doesn't get worse helps heal.  I AM SO GLAD I DID.  She is fine now NO LIMPING no favoring the injured paw!  I am so glad I did not put her through that surgery for both of us.  I am so DISGUSTED WITH BOTH THESE VETS that rush to push SURGERY when there are alternatives!  SHAMEFUL!  You are supposed to help animals not cause more harm.
REPLY TO REPLY:  4 WEEKS later and dog is still fine, not limping and doing great. Your response regarding how well your staff explained things is FALSE no one explain much of anything including the VETERINARIAN.  Just that it was torn and needed surgery. THAT is the point.  Rush to do a $4k surgery. NO alternative treatment.
Thank you for taking the time to post a review.

If you want your dog to die don’t take it to this clinic. Veterinarian Brittany Osejo is EVIL pure and simple. We took our dog to this clinic and spent $1,150.00 in tests because they said it was Pancreatitis and tests came back negative for Pancreatitis. Then, we went a second time and veterinarian Osejo said that “perhaps” it was Cushing’s Disease and refused to do tests immediately and send us home and three hours later our beloved dog passed in our hands.  We will be filing charges civilly and criminally against this Veterinarian. You will be SAVING your dog’s LIFE by avoiding veterinarian Osejo and this CLINIC at all costs!!!

If you have a cat, I’d avoid bringing them to this vet. Just had to go through the process of bringing my cat to three different visits in 4 days because they couldn’t diagnose her properly. She wasn’t eating or drinking for days and they didn’t think to properly check her teeth or do X-Rays and it wasn’t until I pushed them on the third visit I was there did they check properly and find major abscesses in her molars and had to pull them. Got charged $350 for the first visit, $463 for the second visit, and $1,880 for the third visit which was surgery. Spoke to Dr. Williams and voiced my frustration and he clearly showed he didn’t care. This was such an underwhelming experience that it caused a family that’s been taking our cats to this vet for almost 10 years to no longer do so in the future. On top of all that, even when I paid 50% of the high end of the deposit for the surgery ($1,410) upfront, they refused to let my sister see her cat until I followed a link and paid the balance ($400) even though we’ve never not paid a bill up front. It’s clearly all about the money and they really don’t care about the experience the cat or the customer has. Overpriced and careless office. Find a different place.

Got a second opinion, and the surgery was done for $400 with no issues. I feel swindled. No reimbursement, and their estimate included unnecessary, duplicate items we already had from them.

I can't express enough gratitude to the team at Arch Creek Animal Clinic. When my dog, Jack, was facing a serious health issue, they went above and beyond to ensure he received the best possible care.

Not only did they accurately diagnose his condition, but they also took the initiative to refer me to other specialists for further treatment. They personally contacted these veterinarians, coordinated the necessary appointments, and followed up with me multiple times to ensure everything was proceeding smoothly.

Their compassion, professionalism, and genuine concern for Jack's well-being made a challenging time much more manageable. I wholeheartedly recommend Arch Creek Animal Clinic to any pet owner seeking top-notch veterinary care.

My six pups are clients of Arch Creek Animal Clinic 🩵 They are beyond caring and compassionate. The doctor puts up with my million and one questions, they always allow walk ins and even if they’re full, if you ask really nicely they’ll let you come and wait 🤣 The reason I switched over was my number one concern, COSTS. LEGITIMATE COSTS. Having so many animals, when we were at VCA, we spent an arm and a leg, and sometimes we wouldn’t even see the doctor. So many nightmare stories, like, forgetting to give the DHPP vaccine, and having my seven year old long haired Chihuahua get the parvo virus. We tried every VCA. They’re all the same, cold, and expensive. I needed a change. With Arch Creek, I saw so many incredible reviews, and I thought I had nothing to lose by coming for a checkup. They will NEVER EVER tell you to test for something that doesn’t need to be done. You’ll always have an answer,  and you’ll never leave with more questions. They’re ethical, they’re patient and kind, and even if there’s a wait sometimes, it’s because they’re giving every animal the attention they require. The doctors and staff are beyond incredibly knowledgeable, and hospitable. Thank you Arch Creek, our family loves you guys! 🩵 Angelica, Greg, Spencer, Stevie, Blair, Willow, Ellie, and Jack

It's taken me a while to write this review for a doctor who has treated both my own 2 dogs for over 4 years & several rescue animals as well. I didn't want to relive the awful experience I had with Dr. Williams as it has taken a huge emotional toll on me & put a substantial dent in my pocket. I feel deceived & taken advantage of. My dog had an unfortunate accident back in 2020 which prompted me to bring her in as an emergency visit & his partner vet at the time who no longer works there treated my dog & referred us to a neurologist. Fast forward to 2024 she has had ongoing walking problems related to her 2020 accident to which Dr. Williams is fully aware of yet couldn't seem to figure out the cause until I got a second opinion from another vet who seemed to find the problem. Instead of letting the other vet take over I brought my dog & the new x-rays to his office as he is / was her primary vet & I trusted him to look over the notes / images from the other doctor & maybe he could see what the other doctor also saw. He confirmed he sees it & wants to proceed with a CCL surgery which is basically ACL surgery for dogs. His words "if you do not do the surgery soon it's going to cause her other acl to tear as the other leg is overcompensating). I told him I didn't have the money at the time but that I would call him back to schedule the appointment as soon as I did. He informed me that should it be more than 4 months the current estimate would not be honored & new images would need to be taken understandably so. So approx 9 months go by & I have the funds (not really - was just going to put majority on credit & pay what I could cash) as I couldn't bare to see her in pain anymore. I called scheduled the apt fully aware new images / bloodwork would be necessary. The day of the scheduled surgery I brought her in early 8AM fasted ready to go paid the half of the NEW estimate & even waited in the lobby for him to come in at 9AM. I did this for my own anxiety as she was going to be put under anesthesia. He reassured me she was going to be fine & I left. I get a call 2 hours later from the receptionist saying the new x-rays were taken & blood work was done & he no longer feels she needs the surgery & to come & pick Hayley up. When I arrived he was busy tending to other patients & I waited to have a word with him in one of the exam rooms.
I asked him the reason for the change of plans. He apparently did not remember ever telling me 9 months prior that he thinks we should go through with the surgery despite the original estimate that the receptionist found in her file to which I have a picture of with the original date..
He did not want to refund me for the x-rays & bloodwork that they did that morning to which I feel is unfair seeing as how he agreed to do the surgery & she only needed new images & bloodwork FOR SURGERY. Hayley has had at least 3 x-rays done over the course of 4 years in the SAME SPOT. He has all of these images done in his office.
I had no problem paying for new ones as that's what was needed for a surgery he doesn't remember recommending !!!! I couldn't believe what I was hearing.
He is well aware I have been searching for a SOLUTION for my dog's poor gait. He offered nothing to rectify the situation & I truly believe he is money hungry. Dr. Williams when you read this just know the only one suffering is Hayley. Hayley & Nala were loyal clients of yours & the way you discarded us & betrayed us was beyond unacceptable.
